topic: Identify the Egyptian queen allied with Julius Caesar and Mark Antony
core_question: Which Egyptian queen was known for her political and romantic alliances with Julius Caesar and Mark Antony?
answer_summary: Cleopatra (Cleopatra VII), the last active ruler of the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt, allied with Julius Caesar and Mark Antony.
persona: skeptical and testy; writing terse one-liners
